Replay a patched story

Choose a tool and give it the same key story. In forecast mode it predicts the answer after a full donor patch. In edit mode its own direction changes the state, and the table shows the model’s actual answer.

Answers are the winner among the two candidate first tokens. The number below each model answer is its logit lead over the other candidate. Rust marks a forecast or edit error. Green marks an answer flipped by the supplied patch.
